question: Should OpenClaw core add a per-agent backup/restore/clone CLI surface that rewrites agent config, workspace paths, session state, and auth/profile material, or should this stay blocked behind the broader backup/migration design?
rationale: The requested behavior touches persisted state, session history, config rewriting, and sensitive agent auth/profile data, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Design core per-agent restore
options.body: Define a supported archive manifest, restore safety model, clone rewrite rules, and credential/session portability policy before implementation.

options.title: Fold into backup epic
options.body: Keep this issue as a scoped requirement under broader backup/restore work and avoid a separate archive format.

options.title: Document manual recovery only
options.body: Leave per-agent clone unsupported for now and improve docs around safe manual extraction and restore limits.

recommendation.title: Design core per-agent restore
recommendation.body: Define a supported archive manifest, restore safety model, clone rewrite rules, and credential/session portability policy before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the backup CLI surface that would most directly grow the requested command shape, with adjacent review from backup hardening owners.
